components.text: This is a Parasite Villager. Scientist discover that the [ref=stellaris:mobs/parasite]parasite[ref] transform regular villager into this creature.

This alien is pretty passive unless you attack it. [br] But BEWARE ! Scientists discovered that after some time they evolve into an [ref=stellaris:mobs/evolved_parasite_villager]Evolved Parasite Villager[ref]. [br] [br]
